title: P3 proposal: successful bounded UAV response under justified operating conditions (C02)
body:
Process: P3 Verification — **revised proposal; not assigned, not authorized for execution**.
Deliverable: ONE reviewable evidence package assessing successful bounded UAV response in a justified operating domain, its nonvacuity and limitations/counterexamples, plus a separate terminal-response result, article/reviewer wording and HANDOFF.md.
Atomic IDs: primary C02; supporting C03–C05. C01 only related progress/deadlock obligations, without full closure. Existing #39 and R07/#80 ownership remains unchanged.

## Decision status — revision of 2026-10-03

Integrator: **artmus208**, identified by the user. The earlier confirmation (“artmus208, я интегратор. Подтверждаю”) concerned the previous terminal-response proposal. The latest instruction limits current work to **refining the proposal**. Assignment, any environment/model restriction, revised queries/method and execution require a separate decision. Earlier execution wording is superseded: this Issue does not authorize a run.

Owner/stable account-id, Runner/native host and Independent Reviewer: **unassigned**. Authenticated connector/local Git identity vadimnbkg is not an assignment. Reviewer must not be the evidence producer.
Current work: read-only XML analysis and this Issue revision. No verifier query, version probe, new simulation, model change or execution branch for #89. All formulas below have **no machine verdict**.

## Baseline, dependencies and proposed scope

- Base ref: origin/read; exact proposed base: `46bf268c66d6ec2c106ae4ce8e8d5f893315ad91`; PR target: read.
- Proposed branch: `codex/<confirmed-account-id>/89-uav-bounded-response`.
- Proposed write scope after assignment: `evidence/verification/uav-bounded-response-89/**`.
- Everything else read-only: accepted model/generator, shared manager, old queries/evidence, manifests and `levels_tex/samplepaper.tex`. A derived XML inside this scope still needs explicit approval of its restrictions.
- Baseline: `uav-service-completion-r1-20261002`, N=1, 51 processes, one request/result.
- Scientific input commit: `61386aa358805082b705dcd00c8cbfde5fb98248`.
- Manifest: `manifests/baselines/uav-service-completion-r1.yaml`, SHA256 `4b4bf71f55767123cc5934074024179289fa5ad3355fa4c0e37385e8261ef98d`.
- Original model M: `evidence/instantiation/uav-service-completion-candidate/model.xml`, SHA256 `b8ab50e112b71491f8242789cc7906497baf8440c473d7a5a4d5214840187e02`.
- Remaining pins: `evidence/governance/uav-service-completion-baseline-20261002/decision-pins.json` and related inventories.
- Accepted scoped P1/P2/Gate 1: [A/B](https://github.com/artmus208/uppaal_sdn_isac/issues/84#issuecomment-5946722646); [activation C](https://github.com/artmus208/uppaal_sdn_isac/issues/84#issuecomment-5947256320); [v2 activation](https://github.com/artmus208/uppaal_sdn_isac/issues/64#issuecomment-5878071165). PR #86 merged at the proposed base. Historical manifest preparation flags stay unchanged.
- #87 / PR #88 at published HEAD `8c7f60b041dbcd8c2c970b62be15aa0e43e2be8c` remain unaccepted diagnostic inputs. Their merge/acceptance is not a prerequisite under the previous dependency disposition. Eleven timeouts, null verdicts and the old budget deviation are not accepted or inherited here.
- New prerequisites: accepted domain decision, exact derived-model diff/hash if applicable, expanded query hashes/configuration, assignment and explicit execution authorization. No original query/manifest pin is rewritten.

## Main scientific claim

**BR-UAV-success-40(Ω):** for every actual APP request sent under the declared operating conditions Ω, every continuation allowed by those conditions delivers the correct result to APP within **≤40 abstract time units from actual send**.

Correct means the result belongs to this request and its actual stored measurement, satisfies captured quality requirements and arrives with measurement age **<5**. It requires actual correlated APP receipt/Completed, not acceptance, dispatch, a possible success path or a negative terminal outcome.

Define Ω through operating inputs and independently justified contracts, never “the request succeeds”, “delivery happens in time”, future Completed/receipt flags or retrospective removal of unsuccessful executions. Rejection, measurement/queue failure, transport loss, cancellation and timeout **violate the success claim for an in-domain sent request**. Admission is part of its response path, not a new clock origin.

**BR-UAV-terminal-40**, secondary on original full M: every sent request reaches Completed, Rejected, ServiceFailed, ServiceTimeout or Cancelled within ≤40. This measures completion of processing, including negative outcomes. An always-rejecting system could satisfy it; it cannot replace success or independently close C02.

## XML audit: assumptions versus obligations

The following are static observations/inferences, not verification verdicts.

| Aspect | Proposed external operating condition | Component obligation / what XML actually says |
|---|---|---|
| Request/admission | Baseline single safety-UAV demand; healthy external observations and eligible load/resources. | `c82_emit_request()` resets service age only on actual `u0_app_service_request!`. Acceptance depends on fresh telemetry, risk/slice/recovery and policy predicates; initial telemetry is MISSING. B_ADMISSION can lose request/outcome; APP can reject or time out after 15. Establish actual correlated acceptance; do not assume `c82_admitted` or absence of admission loss as input. |
| Measurement | Nominal physical classes and consistent Pd/miss observations. | Start requires a PHY/job rendezvous. Once JobMeasuring starts, duration is 5; a failure edge remains enabled at age 5 even with healthy inputs. Nominal inputs do not compel measurement. |
| Quality | Published E_PHY_INPUT values, within the accepted qualitative abstraction. | Store actual values/IDs and check `c82_payload_quality()` against captured requirements. Strict request classes require nominal quality. A fresh physical input does not automatically mean fresh delivered KPI telemetry. Receipt/quality outcome flags cannot select Ω. |
| Queue | Proposed isolated request: zero background arrivals, original initialization. | Enqueue requires q<K, K=4; overflow is absorbing. Rank is set on insertion. Prove the resulting rank/queue conditions; do not assume favorable rank or absence of overflow instead. |
| Service | Available external resource/demand classes. | SharedLoad ticks every 5. `server=-1` is always permitted; server=0 requires nonempty queue and COMM/JOINT mode. No bounded-service/fairness guarantee follows from nominal resources. |
| Transport | No independent accepted reliability selector exists on the c82 result path. | Transmitting age≤1 bounds an attempt, not delivery. Delivery competes with an unconditional loss edge with the same active/clock guard; loss enters Done without retry. Admission/KPI/control losses also remain. |
| Time/action progress | No accepted fairness/time-divergence premise for this claim. | Idle/Ready/ResultReady/Queued of C82_ResultJob lack local urgency/invariants. Local timeouts neither force useful work nor exclude infinite instantaneous interleavings. Progress remains an obligation. Absence of deadlock alone is insufficient. |

Pinned XML sources: [records/quality/queue functions](https://github.com/artmus208/uppaal_sdn_isac/blob/46bf268c66d6ec2c106ae4ce8e8d5f893315ad91/evidence/instantiation/uav-service-completion-candidate/model.xml#L838), [measurement](https://github.com/artmus208/uppaal_sdn_isac/blob/46bf268c66d6ec2c106ae4ce8e8d5f893315ad91/evidence/instantiation/uav-service-completion-candidate/model.xml#L2340), [APP](https://github.com/artmus208/uppaal_sdn_isac/blob/46bf268c66d6ec2c106ae4ce8e8d5f893315ad91/evidence/instantiation/uav-service-completion-candidate/model.xml#L4027), [PHY environment](https://github.com/artmus208/uppaal_sdn_isac/blob/46bf268c66d6ec2c106ae4ce8e8d5f893315ad91/evidence/instantiation/uav-service-completion-candidate/model.xml#L4357), [admission](https://github.com/artmus208/uppaal_sdn_isac/blob/46bf268c66d6ec2c106ae4ce8e8d5f893315ad91/evidence/instantiation/uav-service-completion-candidate/model.xml#L6362), [SharedLoad/job](https://github.com/artmus208/uppaal_sdn_isac/blob/46bf268c66d6ec2c106ae4ce8e8d5f893315ad91/evidence/instantiation/uav-service-completion-candidate/model.xml#L7894).

### Feasibility conclusion before execution

A positive unconditional success guarantee on full M is not justified. There is a structural obstruction beyond unfavorable raw inputs: immediately before an enabled correct delivery, C82_ResultJob may instead take its internal loss edge to Done. No adverse external selection is needed, and there is no retry. Restricting operating inputs while preserving internal choices cannot eliminate that alternative. If success is reachable in such a domain, a witness does not remove this alternative to success. This is an argument from XML, **not a saved machine counterexample or UPPAAL verdict**.

“No failures occurred” selects outcomes and still leaves service starvation, unbounded handoffs and time-stopped behavior unresolved. Deliberate loss/failure branches are not bugs merely because the stronger claim fails. The XML currently provides **no independently justified sufficient operating domain for a positive BR-UAV-success-40 claim**.

Freshness is a separate bottleneck: a single sample inserted at FIFO rank≥2 needs two dequeues at least 5 units apart. Even with zero other latency, receipt then cannot satisfy sample age<5. Rank=1 is necessary here, not sufficient: slot phase and forwarding delay still matter.

For a future independently supported contract, let bounds be a=send→acceptance, s=acceptance→measurement start, e=measurement storage→enqueue, w=enqueue→actual service, d=service→transmission start, t=transmission start→receipt. Measurement duration is 5 and the transport *attempt* is bounded by 1, but finite s/e/w/d and successful transport are not established. Required obligations include:
- `e+w+d+t < 5` for freshness;
- `a+s+5+e+w+d+t <= 40` for the send-based deadline;
- successful admission/measurement/transport and sufficient progress, independently of those inequalities.

These are **proof obligations, not assumed success conditions or a definition of Ω**. Do not invent missing numerical bounds to fit 40. At age 40 APP also permits timeout: a sufficient universal contract needs strict slack before that race or an independently justified resolution. No priority change is proposed.

## Candidate restricted domain — separate decision required

Propose restricting only explicit external input choices, retaining the full 51-process composition and internal behavior. Candidate **Ωnom / Hnom**, from initialization rather than retrospectively:
1. E_PHY_INPUT selects `p0=2`, `p1…p22=0`, `miss=0`, `scenario=0` at every sample: nominal physical/quality classes, consistent Pd/miss and normal scenario.
2. SharedLoad selects `pick_arrival=0`, `pick_m1…pick_m6=0`: no background enqueue, nominal buffer/delay/drop/demand classes and free external resources.
3. E_FAULT excludes only the externally injected rule/link/node-fault alternatives in the 12–13 window, retaining its existing no-injection alternative and all control/ACK loss/forwarding behavior.
4. Preserve initialization, actual demand/request generation, input/tick timing and skipped-delivery alternatives, every observer, admission/KPI losses, sensing failure, queue mechanics, optional `server=-1`, result loss, cancellation, timeouts and waiting choices. Do not force acceptance/start/service/delivery.

This is a precisely scoped **nominal-input, isolated-load diagnostic region**, not a sufficient domain already established and not a claim of mathematically least restriction. Its minimal intervention is at external selections only. Failure in it is scientifically useful: favorable inputs still do not guarantee a working service. Hnom is neither implemented nor approved. If these operating conditions cannot be justified for the intended use case, keep Ω unresolved; do not fabricate a harness.

The primary formula on Hnom is universal over all retained choices. Use standard symbolic semantics, without added fairness or silently excluded zero-time cycles. A time-stopped-loop counterexample is reported as such; a separate time-divergent/fair claim remains untested. Rejection/loss/failure/timeout/cancellation or lack of component progress cannot count as “leaving the domain”.

Hnom requires a new hash and complete diff from M. Its positive result would apply only to that restricted region, never automatically to full M. A counterexample also claimed for M requires a transition mapping/replay check against M. Removing observers or components is not proposed.

A stronger reliability or bounded-scheduling contract is a **separate P1/P2 question**, not an automatic next attempt. Any later justified restriction must identify excluded behavior, independent rationale, progress conditions and abstraction relation. Preserve deliberate losses in the full baseline and describe the restricted conclusion precisely.

## Proposed formulas and diagnostic order

`S` and `G` below are textual abbreviations for query generation, **not XML variables or assumptions**. Before execution expand them into one-line UTF-8/LF .q files and pin hashes. Do not pass their abbreviation names to verifyta.

`S`:
~~~uppaal
(c82_request_id==1 && c82_active)
~~~

`G` — actual correlated, correctly qualified receipt:
~~~uppaal
(u0_app_Req_0.Completed && c82_request_id==1 && c82_success && c82_received && !c82_active && c82_outcome==1 && c82_admitted && c82_admitted_id==c82_request_id && c82_job_id==c82_request_id && c82_sampled && c82_sample_id==1 && c82_sample_request_id==c82_request_id && c82_enqueued && c82_dispatched && c82_attempted && c82_tx_request_id==c82_request_id && c82_tx_sample_id==c82_sample_id && c82_received_request_id==c82_request_id && c82_received_sample_id==c82_sample_id && !c82_cancelled && !c82_sensing_failed && !c82_tx_lost && !c82_queue_failed && c82_req_fresh==2 && c82_req_update==2 && c82_payload_quality() && c82_receipt_quality && c82_receipt_timely && c82_receipt_sample_band==0 && (c82_receipt_service_band==1 || c82_receipt_service_band==2))
~~~

Receipt records describe quality/freshness at receipt. Do not require sample age<5 forever after Completed: that clock continues advancing. The explicit service-age test below is evaluated when the required response state is reached.

| Slot | Model | Formula | Purpose | Cap |
|---|---|---|---|---:|
| 1 | Hnom | `E<> S` | Actual send within this domain. | 180 s |
| 2 | Hnom | Q2 below | Actual correlated admission in this domain. | 180 s |
| 3 | Hnom | `E<> (G && c82_service_age<=c82_D_service)` | Useful path through send/admission/measurement/enqueue/service/attempt/correct fresh receipt. Inspect witness order and IDs, not flags alone. | 180 s |
| 4 | Hnom | `S --> (G && c82_service_age<=c82_D_service)` | **Primary universal BR-UAV-success-40(Ωnom)**. Negative outcomes do not discharge it. | 600 s |
| 5 | Hnom | Q5 below | Deadlock before APP terminal outcome, including cancellation handoff. | 180 s |
| 6 | Original M | Q6 below | **Secondary BR-UAV-terminal-40**, including original environment choices and negative outcomes. | 180 s |

Q2:
~~~uppaal
E<> (c82_request_id==1 && c82_active && c82_admitted && c82_admitted_id==c82_request_id && (u0_app_Req_0.Accepted || u0_app_Req_0.AcceptedDegraded))
~~~

Q5:
~~~uppaal
A[] ((c82_request_id==1 && !(u0_app_Req_0.Completed || u0_app_Req_0.Rejected || u0_app_Req_0.ServiceFailed || u0_app_Req_0.ServiceTimeout || u0_app_Req_0.Cancelled)) imply not deadlock)
~~~

Q6:
~~~uppaal
(c82_request_id==1 && c82_active) --> ((u0_app_Req_0.Completed || u0_app_Req_0.Rejected || u0_app_Req_0.ServiceFailed || u0_app_Req_0.ServiceTimeout || u0_app_Req_0.Cancelled) && !c82_active && c82_outcome>=1 && c82_outcome<=5 && c82_service_age<=c82_D_service)
~~~

The active trigger avoids new obligations after a completed one-shot request while its clock advances. It does not exempt rejection: the earlier sent/active state still requires a later G in Q4. Cancellation is recorded before APP enters Cancelled, hence Q5/Q6 require actual locations.

Slots 1–3 use **exactly the same domain/model as Q4**, not broad M or a selected historical trace. Q3 includes substantive causal stages, not merely `E<> Completed`; it cannot replace universal Q4. A positive Q4 is scientifically insufficient if domain validity/nonvacuity is unresolved. No acceptance-only trigger or fairness reformulation is substituted after a counterexample.

[UPPAAL symbolic-query semantics](https://docs.uppaal.org/language-reference/query-semantics/symb_queries/) define leads-to as `A[] (p imply A<> q)`, including subsequent action/delay choices. Reachability and deadlock checks do not replace that obligation.

First complete domain/contract review and approve or reject Hnom; materialize only an approved diff and freeze hashes. If domain selection is unresolved, **do not execute**. If sending is disproved, mark the domain vacuous; dependent success work is not scientifically established. Missing witnesses/timeouts remain explicit gaps, with no automatic replacement queries.
Keep static age-5/40 boundary analysis and boundary behavior present in witnesses. The former separate equality queries are removed to allocate slots to admission and separate success/terminal claims.

## Proposed budget and method — no execution permission

No increase to the previous ceiling:
- **At most six search attempts, one reserved slot per query, sequential. No retry, continuation, spare control or hidden smoke query.**
- Q4: 600 s; five others: 180 s each; **1500 s total search allocation**.
- **1800 s whole native session**, first verifier preflight through owned-process cleanup, including overhead. Reserve stop margin; report any overrun honestly.
- Sampled memory stop: floor(min(0.5 × measured physical RAM, 8 GiB)/MiB) MiB; WorkingSet/RSS monitoring, not a hard allocation guarantee.
- Proposed symbolic DFS/diagnostic trace: `-o 1 -t 0 -X <prefix>`, checked against actual help. Q1–Q5 on approved Hnom; Q6 on exact M. No additional full-M success attempt in this budget.
- Native Windows Python + Windows verifyta.exe, or native Linux pair; no cross-OS PID monitoring. Record actual version/executable hash; historical expected version UPPAAL 5.0.0 rev. 714BA9DB36F49691 is not a substituted observation.
- Timeout/memory_limit gives null verdict; unused reserved slots may proceed within remaining budget. Error, version/license/monitor mismatch or watchdog/stop failure halts the series. Interrupted pre-reserved slot counts as used.
- Preserve negative verdicts/counterexamples. No automatic restriction, parameter change, fairness addition, repair, query weakening or second campaign follows. Old timeouts justify no extra attempts.

Scoped driver only; shared manager read-only. Independent native watchdog uses monotonic deadlines and owned process handles, not JSON status reads. Windows Job Object kill-on-close owns children before execution, or native Linux process group. Synthetic children test stop/resource/JSON-failure handling before UPPAAL; they are not model-checking control runs.
Before long/native calls, checkpoint and publish approved protocol/domain/diff, queries/hashes, pins, ledger and driver/config, or export a complete owner-accessible bundle. Persist consumed slots/raw results durably. Never label an Hnom result with M's hash.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Reviewed operating domain separates external inputs from obligations for admission, measurement, quality, queue, service, transport and progress. Every restriction has a rationale; unproved obligations remain open. No selection by successful/timely outcome.
2. BR-UAV-success-40 remains the main question. Terminal processing is reported separately. Rejection/failure/timeout never becomes successful delivery.
3. Exact pins, approved Hnom diff/hash if used, six expanded query hashes/config, assignment and execution authorization precede runs. Proposed Hnom retains 51 processes and internal loss/failure choices.
4. Nonvacuity covers actual send, admission and a causal successful chain **inside that same domain**, with temporal order/IDs inspected. An old M success trace is not a substitute.
5. Explicit machine Q4 result with proof/counterexample artifacts, or an honest no-result/inconclusive disposition. Classify a negative trace: admission, measurement, quality/freshness, queue/service starvation, transport loss, cancellation, timeout, deadlock or instantaneous loop. Keep static reasoning separate from machine evidence.
6. Q5 is not presented as proof of time progress. Q6 is independent of Q4, with its model scope explicit. Unexecuted, boundary and fairness obligations are listed.
7. Each run saves run_id/status/verdict/model_hash/query_hash/actual full tool_version/executable hash; source/base/commit, parameters/vector, exact command/options, environment/hardware, UTC times, wall/CPU/peak and raw stdout/stderr/telemetry/trace hashes. Missing metrics/verdicts are null with reasons.
8. Negative/inconclusive evidence can be an honest accepted research deliverable, **not proof of success or automatic C02 closure**. Preserve the requirement and counterexample; distinguish intentional failure from a defect against an accepted contract.
9. A demonstrated defect gets a separate repair task; retain original counterexample/baseline. No repair of model/generator or manuscript belongs to #89.
10. Article/reviewer fragments distinguish guaranteed success, terminal processing, existential feasibility and open claims; identify checked conditions/model. No automatic transfer from a restricted model.
11. Offline integrity/scope/budget audit, relevant CONTRIBUTING checks and `git diff --check`, preserving failures. Static/software checks are not verification evidence.
12. Durable branch or full bundle, HEAD/base/branch/clean-dirty/reproduction handoff and PR into read; independent acceptance. No self-acceptance, full P3/Gate 2/R07 claim or manuscript edits.

## Prepared separate task: contract clarification / possible repair

**Draft title:** P2: resolve UAV result-path progress and reliability contracts before claiming successful bounded response.
Status: proposal only; no assignment, new Issue creation, repair permission or extra verification budget.

Problem: accepted one-shot behavior permits failure during healthy measurement, loss immediately before valid delivery, optional lack of MAC service and locally unbounded handoffs. These obstruct the stronger guarantee but do not by themselves establish a bug in the accepted abstraction.

Requested result:
- Compare each obstruction with accepted P1/P2 contracts; identify intentional behavior versus an actual transition/contract discrepancy. Attach the original saved counterexample when available.
- Define independently meaningful reliability assumptions and component obligations: admission/KPI readiness, measurement start, rank/slot phase, bounded handoff/service, freshness <5, age-40 timeout race and time progress.
- If a defect is established, propose the smallest justified generator/model repair and regression scenario **preserving intended loss/failure modes**, rather than deleting them for success. Otherwise record why the stronger guarantee is unsupported.
- State exact conditional scope and any abstraction/transfer argument. A corrected/new baseline needs its own P1/P2/Gate decision.

Owner/reviewer, exact fix paths, base, dependencies and budget must be assigned in that separate Issue before changes. No overlap with an active write scope, manuscript edit or manifest change without corresponding authorization. #89 does not expand into this work.
